findings.source_passage: She grinned. 'I'll always be there to give you the good news, now get going.'
findings.source_locator: After 'Thanks. That really helps.' and before 'Heather stepped aside.'
findings.why_it_matters: This is a character-voice line that completes Heather's sardonic send-off exchange; without it, her personality is truncated and the goodbye feels abrupt rather than warmly comic.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore Heather's closing quip verbatim or near-verbatim before Miriam leaps into the portal.

findings.source_passage: I grinned up at them. 'Um, hi. You don't happen to-' My eyes noticed a large stain over the stones.
findings.source_locator: After Miriam stumbles onto the stone platform, before she asks 'Where's Xander?'
findings.why_it_matters: Miriam's interrupted quip on arrival is a signature voice beat — deflecting shock with attempted humor — and its erasure collapses her narrator register at a pivotal re-entry moment.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the attempted one-liner ('Um, hi. You don't happen to-') cut short by the blood stain, to preserve the narrator's characteristic voice and the tonal contrast with what she sees.

findings.source_passage: I blinked at him and glanced at his back. 'I don't think I'd-' My mistake was cut short when the slits in the back of his cloak parted
findings.source_locator: When Apuleius offers his back before revealing his wings
findings.why_it_matters: The interrupted protest followed by the wing reveal is a comedic-ironic beat that defines Miriam's narrating voice; the draft skips straight to the wings, losing the signature rhythm of assumption-then-surprise.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore Miriam's skeptical half-sentence before the wing reveal so the comedic interruption structure is preserved.

findings.source_passage: Like any unprofessional rider I clung tightly to his neck and prayed.
findings.source_locator: After Apuleius sweeps Miriam into the air
findings.why_it_matters: The self-deprecating aside ('like any unprofessional rider') is a small but characteristic voice marker; its omission continues a pattern of trimming the narrator's ironic asides.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'unprofessional rider' beat in the flight sentence.

findings.source_passage: Stephanie. Darda stood behind them with her husband.
findings.source_locator: Description of those gathered at Xander's bedside
findings.why_it_matters: Stephanie's presence at Xander's bedside is a character-continuity detail; her omission silently erases a named character from the scene.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Stephanie and Darda's husband to the bedside assembly list.

summary: The draft strips multiple consecutive ironic/comedic voice beats from Miriam's narration (the interrupted quip on arrival, the half-protest before the wing reveal, the 'unprofessional rider' aside, Heather's closing one-liner), producing three medium-severity voice-flattening findings that collectively trigger regeneration.
